+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    s.replace(ps, c) for every (a, b, ps, c) of table, in order, skipping the
+    replacements that cannot match: present is a superset of the characters
+    of s (its initial characters plus every token minted since), so a pair
+    with a character outside it does not occur in s and replacing it would
+    be a no-op.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    for a, b, ps, c in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            n = len(s)
+            s = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if len(s) != n:
+                present.add(c)
+    return s
+
